text: - **#2363** NS decision/prep: extract nmp-gallery as external consumer repo — **DECIDED NO-GO; Gallery stays in-tree** (conformance harness, not product; see key decisions). Rule: *products live outside (Chirp); conformance harnesses live in-tree (Gallery).* [...] - **Gallery stays in-tree** — it's a conformance harness, not a product (extraction explicitly rejected). Rule: products live outside, harnesses live in-tree.
